source: 1-loop massless cutbubble at eps = 1/2 (D = 3) — Phase 3 oracle for the ε-extremes axis (large-eps boundary).  Same cutbubble family as cutbubble_1L_eps001 but evaluated at eps = 1/2 (i.e., D = 4 - 2*eps = 3).  Note: an initial attempt at eps = 1 (D = 2) hit an upstream MMA AMFlow limitation where the DESolver returned a partially-symbolic expression (1/2π) Im[DESolver`Private`variables[1, 1]], so eps = 1/2 was chosen as the next-most-extreme rational eps that yields a clean numeric result.  At eps = 1/2 the answer is 1/8 to ~60 digits (massless 2-particle phase space at s = 4 in D = 3).

cpp_sampled_status.result: completed and matches Mathematica reference at rel = 1.9 × 10⁻⁶⁴ (essentially full-precision agreement on 1/8).  Phase 3 ε-extremes oracle at the large-eps end (D = 3 dimensional regularization).  No audit divergence surfaced — the C++ Laurent-expansion / DESolver paths handle eps = 1/2 without issue.
cpp_sampled_status.note: C++ wallclock 17 s, MMA 25 s.  At eps = 1/2 the integral is exactly 1/8 (massless 2-particle phase space at s = 4 in D = 3), and both sides agree to ~64 digits.  Compare via tools/bench/compare_sampled.py.
